description: A jQuery plugin for rotating images, supporting CSS transforms and VML for IE, with functions to rotate, get angle, and stop rotation.

classes.name: Wilq32.PhotoEffect
classes.description: Main class handling image rotation, supporting CSS and VML for IE.

methods.name: _setupParameters
methods.description: Initializes rotation parameters such as angle, center, duration, easing, and callback.

methods.name: _handleRotation
methods.description: Handles the rotation process, initiating animation or applying CSS transform.

methods.name: _BindEvents
methods.description: Binds event handlers to the image or container.

methods.name: _Loader
methods.description: Loads the image into VML or Canvas depending on browser support.

methods.name: _animate
methods.description: Performs the animation step, updating rotation over time.

methods.name: _rotate
methods.description: Applies rotation to the image via CSS, Canvas, or VML.
